import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Read the Excel file, skipping the header row
df = pd.read_excel('/workspace/pone.0150501.s002.xls', header=None)

# The actual data starts at row 1 (row 0 is the header text, row 1 is column names)
# Row 1 has: first col = miRNA name, rest are sample names P_1..P_10, C_11..C_20
# Rows 2 onwards are miRNA data

# Set up column names from row 1
df.columns = df.iloc[0].values
df = df.iloc[1:].reset_index(drop=True)

# Rename first column
df = df.rename(columns={df.columns[0]: 'miRNA'})

# Convert numeric columns
sample_cols = df.columns[1:]
for col in sample_cols:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head().to_string())

# Identify patient and control columns
patient_cols = [c for c in sample_cols if str(c).startswith('P_')]
control_cols = [c for c in sample_cols if str(c).startswith('C_')]

print(f"\nPatient columns ({len(patient_cols)}): {patient_cols}")
print(f"Control columns ({len(control_cols)}): {control_cols}")
print(f"Total miRNAs: {len(df)}")

# Perform t-test for each miRNA (patient vs control), no correction
results = []
for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    miRNA = row['miRNA']
    patient_vals = row[patient_cols].dropna().astype(float).values
    control_vals = row[control_cols].dropna().astype(float).values

    if len(patient_vals) >= 2 and len(control_vals) >= 2:
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(patient_vals, control_vals, equal_var=False)
        results.append({
            'miRNA': miRNA,
            't_stat': t_stat,
            'p_value': p_val,
            'patient_mean': np.mean(patient_vals),
            'control_mean': np.mean(control_vals),
            'log2_fc': np.log2(np.mean(patient_vals) / np.mean(control_vals)) if np.mean(control_vals) > 0 else np.nan
        })

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
print(f"\nNumber of miRNAs with valid t-tests: {len(results_df)}")

# Significance threshold before multiple testing correction
alpha = 0.05
significant = results_df[results_df['p_value'] < alpha]
num_significant = len(significant)
pct_significant = (num_significant / len(results_df)) * 100

print(f"\nSignificant miRNAs (p < {alpha}, before correction): {num_significant}")
print(f"Percentage: {pct_significant:.1f}%")

# Show all results sorted by p-value
print("\nAll miRNAs sorted by p-value:")
print(results_df.sort_values('p_value').to_string())

# Summary
print(f"\n=== SUMMARY ===")
print(f"Total miRNAs tested: {len(results_df)}")
print(f"Significant at p < 0.05 (uncorrected): {num_significant}")
print(f"Percentage: {pct_significant:.1f}%")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Read the Excel file with no header
df = pd.read_excel('/workspace/pone.0150501.s002.xls', header=None)

# Row 0: title, Row 1: column names (P_1..P_20), Data: rows 2 onwards
# Column 0: miRNA name, Columns 1-10: patients (P_1..P_10), Columns 11-20: controls (C_11..C_20)

# Extract data starting from row 2
data = df.iloc[2:].reset_index(drop=True)
data.columns = ['miRNA'] + [f'P_{i}' for i in range(1, 11)] + [f'C_{i}' for i in range(11, 21)]

# Convert numeric columns
for col in data.columns[1:]:
    data[col] = pd.to_numeric(data[col], errors='coerce')

print("Shape:", data.shape)
print("Columns:", data.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst 5 rows:")
print(data.head().to_string())

patient_cols = [f'P_{i}' for i in range(1, 11)]
control_cols = [f'C_{i}' for i in range(11, 21)]

print(f"\nPatient columns ({len(patient_cols)}): {patient_cols}")
print(f"Control columns ({len(control_cols)}): {control_cols}")
print(f"Total miRNAs: {len(data)}")

# Perform Welch's t-test for each miRNA
results = []
for idx, row in data.iterrows():
    miRNA = row['miRNA']
    patient_vals = row[patient_cols].dropna().astype(float).values
    control_vals = row[control_cols].dropna().astype(float).values

    if len(patient_vals) >= 2 and len(control_vals) >= 2:
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(patient_vals, control_vals, equal_var=False)
        results.append({
            'miRNA': miRNA,
            't_stat': t_stat,
            'p_value': p_val,
            'patient_mean': np.mean(patient_vals),
            'control_mean': np.mean(control_vals)
        })

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
print(f"\nNumber of miRNAs tested: {len(results_df)}")

# Significance threshold before multiple testing correction
alpha = 0.05
significant = results_df[results_df['p_value'] < alpha]
num_significant = len(significant)
pct_significant = (num_significant / len(results_df)) * 100

print(f"\nSignificant miRNAs (p < {alpha}, before correction): {num_significant}")
print(f"Percentage: {pct_significant:.1f}%")

# Show significant results
print("\nSignificant miRNAs sorted by p-value:")
print(significant.sort_values('p_value').to_string())

# Full results
print("\n\nAll miRNAs sorted by p-value:")
print(results_df.sort_values('p_value').to_string())

print(f"\n=== FINAL ANSWER ===")
print(f"Total miRNAs tested: {len(results_df)}")
print(f"Significant at p < 0.05 (uncorrected): {num_significant}")
print(f"Percentage: {pct_significant:.1f}%")
